content.title: About IEEE
content.text: The world’s largest technical professional organization, IEEE is dedicated to advancing technology for the benefit of humanity. 500K+ members globally in more than 190 countries 189K Student members worldwide 347 Sections in ten global geographic Regions Our Mission Driving Innovation IEEE is a global network of over 500,000 engineering and STEM professionals. Our core purpose is to foster technological innovation and excellence for the benefit of humanity. Building a Better World From education and professional development to research and humanitarian outreach, IEEE's work aims to advance technology for the public good. Global Public Policy IEEE is a trusted voice representing technology professionals and their needs to governments around the world. History IEEE's story reaches back to the 19th century. It reflects every facet of engineering and technology, and embraces innovations by experts across fields. Membership IEEE members and communities share knowledge locally and around the world, developing industry-wide standards and fostering innovation. Learn More About IEEE See the Annual Report, Strategic Plan, and more. Contact IEEE Access the Support Center, submit a question, or call. Newsroom Find the latest news from IEEE around the world. IEEE Leadership Get to know the people representing the interests of technologists globally. Explore More Learn more about how IEEE is working to advance technology for the benefit of humanity.
